evidence: Applied the check-probe-not-in-seed.py procedure by hand (private checker not executed; this is a manual application, not a portal checker run). Frozen hashes re-verified: environment/assets/kittle.json and solution/app/seed/kittle.json both 42ab8b97... (byte-identical), server.js a8a4a561..., app.js 3875be4e..., index.html 6a49714f..., functional judge.toml 43a0c135..., matching manifest.json. (1) Probe inventory: grep -ohE 'JUDGE-[A-Z0-9]+' over tests/ yields 28 distinct sentinels, all in tests/scored/functional/judge.toml: JUDGE-CS1, D1, D2, E1, F1, F2, H0, H1, H2, L1, LA, LE, LV, M1, M2, O, P1, P2, P3, R0, R1, R1B, R2, R3, RX, U1, U2, WL1. Gates, polish and visual create no named values (polish refusal_in_place uses a wrong password / stale edit with no named literal). (2) grep -rn -i 'JUDGE' environment/ solution/ instruction.md returns nothing: no sentinel is in the seed, the reference markup (index.html, app.js, CSS) or server.js. (3) Non-sentinel created phrases were also grepped in environment/ and solution/ with zero hits: 'Lease question', 'See the M-12 terms', 'please review', 'survey update', 'Too late', 'Root question', 'Level one/two/three', 'Unrelated', 'Another level', 'Hold parent', 'Hold child', 'Not really', 'Version one/two/stale', 'Notes ', 'quoted line', 'See draft', 'Temp ', 'Gone soon', 'Unread one/two', 'Sent once', 'Order A/B', 'Live arrival', 'Half typed', 'example.org', 'alert(7/8/9'. The only '@Dev' hit is a code comment at server.js:208, not data. (4) Reference initial state: seedDatabase (server.js:93-128) inserts only seed accounts/matters/walls/messages/versions/reads and calls recordMentions on seed bodies; no seed body contains '@' (all 31 '@' in kittle.json are emails in author/client/walled/read_up_to fields), so Dev's mentions list starts empty and the JUDGE-M2 presence / JUDGE-M1 absence check is not pre-decided. The only other message insert is the POST path (server.js:409). init() (157-165) adds nothing else. (5) Absence probes are not pre-falsified by unrelated seed text: 'Probate'/'2,400'/'4,200' occur only in K-13 and its version; 'Insurer letter' only in K-17; 'original lease scan' only in K-1; 'rent review date' only in K-10 (K-11 'Rent review meeting...' lacks 'date'); 'heads of terms', 'Fenwick', 'Schedule 4' only in M-12 (M-11's K-16 has 'Schedule 2' with no '4' token). (6) Cross-probe collisions: search probes 'JUDGE-D1', 'JUDGE-F1', 'JUDGE-O' are not substrings of any other sentinel (JUDGE-R1 is a substring of JUDGE-R1B but nested_replies uses no search). Deliberate seeded fixtures that resemble probes ('On hold' inside K-16, the markup in K-16) are seeded inputs for the safe_formatting/hold-badge checks, not judge-created mutation proofs, and do not pre-satisfy the JUDGE-H2 no-badge check (that check asserts absence of a badge, which a seed cannot supply). Counterexample attempts: a dead app that never writes cannot show JUDGE-CS1, JUDGE-D1 (exactly once), JUDGE-R0..R3 nesting, JUDGE-U1/U2 counts, JUDGE-E1 versions, or JUDGE-M2 mentions, because none of those values exist before the judge creates them; a conforming app cannot fail because of a pre-existing collision, since none exists in the seed it must import. Runtime cross-check: raw-evidence-index cites the 8 Oct scripted golden (run_golden.sh/functional.cjs) against the same source hashes; it is not a configured judge run and is not needed for this static seed/markup check.
